description: This file defines the ModuleNode class within the Twig templating engine, representing a module node in the Twig AST. It includes methods to compile the node into PHP code, handle parent templates, traits, blocks, macros, and debugging information.

classes.name:
Twig
ode inal class ModuleNode
classes.description: Represents a module node in the Twig AST, responsible for compiling Twig templates into PHP classes. It manages the template's body, parent, blocks, macros, traits, and embedded templates, providing methods to generate corresponding PHP code with proper handling for traits, parent templates, and debug info.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ModuleNode with template components such as body, parent, blocks, macros, traits, embedded templates, and source context.

methods.name: setIndex
methods.description: Sets the index attribute of the ModuleNode, which may be used for template identification.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Main method to compile the node into PHP code, invoking sub-methods to generate class header, constructor, display logic, etc.

methods.name: compileTemplate
methods.description: Handles the compilation of the overall template classes including header, constructor, and core methods.

methods.name: compileGetParent
methods.description: Generates code for the doGetParent method, determining parent template loading.

methods.name: compileClassHeader
methods.description: Generates the class declaration, including use statements and class definition.

methods.name: compileConstructor
methods.description: Generates the constructor method code, initializing traits, blocks, and parent templates.

methods.name: compileDisplay
methods.description: Generates the doDisplay method responsible for rendering the template, managing parent templates and blocks.

methods.name: compileClassFooter
methods.description: Closes the class definition by generating the class footer.

methods.name: compileMacros
methods.description: Generates code related to macros defined in the template.

methods.name: compileGetTemplateName
methods.description: Creates the getTemplateName method returning the template's name.

methods.name: compileIsTraitable
methods.description: Determines if the template is usable as a trait and generates the isTraitable method.

methods.name: compileDebugInfo
methods.description: Generates the getDebugInfo method for debugging purposes.

methods.name: compileGetSourceContext
methods.description: Creates the getSourceContext method that returns source code, name, and path info.

methods.name: compileLoadTemplate
methods.description: Loads and assigns a template node to a variable, used primarily for traits.
